seoTitle: How to Permanently Delete Your Namecheap Account
metaDescription: Ready to close your Namecheap account for good? Learn the exact steps to log in, request account deletion, and confirm the permanent cancellation.
intro: Whether you're switching to another registrar or simply cleaning up unused accounts, permanently deleting a Namecheap account requires going through account settings rather than just letting it sit idle. This guide walks through logging in, requesting deletion, and confirming the process.

steps.heading: Log in to your Namecheap account
steps.body: Sign in to Namecheap with your account credentials to access your profile and account settings.

steps.heading: Open your profile settings
steps.body: Navigate to the profile or account management section where account-level actions, including deletion, are located.

steps.heading: Request account deletion
steps.body: Find the option to request permanent deletion of your account and follow the prompts to begin the closure process.

steps.heading: Confirm the deletion request
steps.body: Complete any confirmation steps Namecheap requires, such as verifying your identity or confirming via email.

steps.heading: Verify the account is closed
steps.body: After the process completes, confirm you can no longer log in, indicating the account has been successfully deleted.

faq.question: Can I delete my Namecheap account if I still have active domains?
faq.answer: Active domains or services can complicate deletion, so it's best to resolve or transfer those before requesting account closure.

faq.question: Is deleting a Namecheap account reversible?
faq.answer: No, permanent deletion is meant to be final, so make sure you no longer need the account before confirming.

faq.question: Will deleting my account remove my domain registrations too?
faq.answer: Domains typically need to be transferred or expired separately, since account deletion doesn't automatically remove active domain registrations.

faq.question: How long does the deletion process take?
faq.answer: It varies, but the request and confirmation steps are generally completed within the same session once initiated.
